paper_identity.title: Pygmy Quadrupole Resonance in skin nuclei

cross_mass_significance: Discovers the emergence of the Pygmy Quadrupole Resonance (PQR) at low excitation energies (Ex ~ 2hbar*omega - shift) in neutron-skin nuclei (58Ni -> 68Ni -> 78Ni, and Sn isotopes): proves that weakly bound excess neutrons decouple from the isospin-saturated core, generating an out-of-phase skin oscillation that violates standard isoscalar/isovector giant quadrupole sum rule distributions, while expanding the IVGQR damping width by >2x due to continuum Landau damping.
